note: Fictional company and sample markets, built in three Developer Edition orgs for the demo.
findings: 1 of 3 orgs extracted; 14 of 37 markets found in the extracted orgs.
68 custom components classified: 34% adopt standard, 12% replace with configuration, 10% retain, 0% harmonise, 1% retire, 43% review with client.
Cross-org comparison starts once a second org is extracted.
1 component is unused and can be retired before any move.
29 components are not matched to a known capability and go on the workshop agenda.
